card.name: Words just before patients or a patient group
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifying words (of, the, critical, susceptible, younger) that come right before a noun like patients, area or period in warning text about risk in a group.

modes.label: Of after a percentage
modes.description: The word of after a percent figure, just before patients.
modes.example: about 2% to 4%<< of>> patients treated for one year.

modes.label: The before a period or group
modes.description: The word the after in, leading into a post-event period in NSAID risk text.
modes.example: patients treated with NSAIDs in<< the>> post-MI period were at increased risk

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: A describing word placed before patients or area.
modes.example: More serious or even fatal course of chickenpox or measles in<< susceptible>> patients
